title: A functor out of a cofiltered category satisfying the two lifting conditions is initial; colimits over the opposite categories agree
statement: (0) Let $\mathcal I$ be a cofiltered category and $i\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal I)$; then the category $\mathcal I/i$ whose objects are the morphisms $a:j\to i$ and whose morphisms $a'\to a$ ($a':j'\to i$) are the $b:j'\to j$ with $a\circ b=a'$ is cofiltered. (1) Let $\mathcal A$ be a cofiltered category, $\mathcal B$ a category and $H:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ a functor such that (i) for every object $y$ of $\mathcal B$ there are an object $x$ of $\mathcal A$ and a morphism $H(x)\to y$, and (ii) for every object $y$ of $\mathcal B$, every object $x$ of $\mathcal A$ and every two morphisms $s,s':H(x)\to y$ there is a morphism $t:x'\to x$ in $\mathcal A$ with $s\circ H(t)=s'\circ H(t)$. Then $H$ is initial (Stacks Categories, Definition of an initial functor, the dual of Definition 04E6), $\mathcal B$ is cofiltered, and for every functor $M:\mathcal B^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal C$ into any category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] the colimit of $M$ exists if and only if the colimit of $M\circ H^{\mathrm{op}}:\mathcal A^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal C$ exists, and then the canonical map $\varinjlim_{\mathcal A^{\mathrm{op}}}M\circ H^{\mathrm{op}}\to\varinjlim_{\mathcal B^{\mathrm{op}}}M$ (induced by the coprojections $\iota_{H(x)}$) is an isomorphism.
